title: CloudWatch and distributed observability
summary: Amazon CloudWatch collects metrics, logs, and alarms; AWS X-Ray traces request paths across services. Learn custom metrics and dimensions, Logs Insights queries, alarm design that pages humans only when needed, trace propagation through Lambda and SQS, and a production debug runbook for the Lambda-plus-SQS stack — the observability toolkit senior on-call engineers rely on.

topics.title: CloudWatch metrics (namespaces, dimensions, and custom metrics)
CloudWatch Logs (groups, streams, and Logs Insights)
CloudWatch alarms (thresholds, composite, and anomaly detection)
AWS X-Ray tracing (segments, subsegments, and service map)
